dialogue.content: こんにちは。カウンセラーのはなまると申します。今日はよろしくお願いします。まず、ご年齢と性別を教えて頂けますか？
dialogue.English: Hello. My name is Hanamaru, and I'll be your counselor today. It's a pleasure to speak with you. First, could you please tell me your age and gender?

dialogue.content: こんにちは宜しくお願いします30代女性です
dialogue.English: Hello, it's nice to meet you. I'm a woman in my 30s.

dialogue.content: 教えて下さりありがとうございます。では、今日のご相談内容を教えて頂けますか？
dialogue.English: Thank you for sharing that. Could you tell me what you’d like to talk about today?

dialogue.content: 早寝早起きをしたいと思っているのに、なかなか出来ません
dialogue.English: I want to go to bed early and get up early, but I just can't seem to do it.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。早寝早起きは体を整えるためには大切ですよね。ご相談者さんが、何時に寝て何時に起きているか、具体的な今の状況を教えて頂けますか？
dialogue.English: I see. Going to bed early and getting up early is important for keeping your body in a good rhythm, isn't it? Could you share a bit about your current routine—what time you usually go to bed and what time you get up?

dialogue.content: 寝るのは1:00～2:00amくらいで、朝はその日の予定によって違いますが、予定がないとダラダラしてしまいます
dialogue.English: I usually go to bed around 1:00 or 2:00 AM. What time I get up in the morning depends on my plans for the day, but if I don't have any, I tend to laze around.

dialogue.content: 寝る時間は少し遅めなんですね。予定がないと朝ダラダラしてしまいたくなるお気持ちはよく分かります。寝るのが遅いのは何か理由があるのですか？
dialogue.English: Your bedtime is a bit late, isn't it? I completely understand the feeling of wanting to lounge around in the morning when you have no plans. Is there any particular reason you stay up so late?

dialogue.content: 全くないんです昔からの習性です
dialogue.English: Not at all—it’s just a long-standing habit.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。朝起きるがおつらい感覚はありますか？
dialogue.English: I see. Do you find it difficult to get up in the morning?

dialogue.content: あります
dialogue.English: Yes, I do.

dialogue.content: 寝る時間まで何をされているのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: What do you usually do until bedtime?

dialogue.content: Youtubeや映画を見てしまいます
dialogue.English: I end up watching YouTube or movies.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。寝る前のYouTubeはすごくお気持ち分かります。ぐりさんは早寝早起きをしたいとのことですが、なぜそう思われるのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see. I can certainly understand watching YouTube before bed. You mentioned wanting to go to bed and get up earlier—why is that important to you?

dialogue.content: まず身体に良くないですし、一日の時間を有効に使えない気がするので
dialogue.English: Well, for one, it's not good for my health, and I feel like I'm not making good use of my day.

dialogue.content: そうですね。本当にその通りだと思います。日中を有効に過ごしたいと考えれば、朝の時間は大切です。そのためには、早寝をしないと朝早く起きれないですね。
dialogue.English: Yes, I completely agree. If you want to make the most of your day, the morning is crucial. To be able to get up early, you need to go to bed early, right?

dialogue.content: そうなんです寝る時間はいつも遅いのに、朝早く起きなければいけないと、昼間眠くて仕事になりません
dialogue.English: Exactly. Even though I always go to bed late, when I have to get up early, I'm too sleepy during the day to focus on work.

dialogue.content: その時は反省するのですが、直りません
dialogue.English: I feel bad about it at the time, but I can't seem to break the habit.

dialogue.content: 寝る時間が遅くなると、日中眠くなりますよね。でも、ぐりさんにとって、寝るまでのYouTubeや映画を観る時間はストレス発散のためには必要な時間なんでしょうね。
dialogue.English: When you go to bed late, you get sleepy during the day, don't you? But for you, the time spent watching YouTube or movies until bedtime is probably necessary for stress relief, right?

dialogue.content: 一日中忙しかった日は、すぐ寝てしまうのが嫌で見てしまうのですが、
dialogue.English: On days when I've been busy all day, I end up watching them because I hate the idea of going straight to sleep,

dialogue.content: 特にそうでもなかった日も、無理して見てる感じなんです
dialogue.English: but even on days that weren't particularly busy, it feels like I'm forcing myself to watch.

dialogue.content: その日のストレスを発散したり、夜ゆっくり過ごしたいお気持ちは本当にすごく分かりますよ。その時間がぐりさんにとって、すごく大切な時間になっているのですね。
dialogue.English: I completely understand wanting to unwind from the day's stress and have a relaxing evening. That time has become very important to you, hasn't it?

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: Yes, that's right.

dialogue.content: 問題なのは、寝る時間が遅くなると、日中の生活の質が下がるということ。日中眠くて困ることで、具体的に何かありますか？
dialogue.English: The challenge is that going to bed late lowers the quality of your daytime life. When you’re sleepy during the day, what specific problems does that cause?

dialogue.content: 眠くて困る時はコーヒーを沢山のんだり、出来るだけ動くようにしたりするのですが、やろうと計画してたことが、時間が足りなくなってできなくなるのが嫌なんです
dialogue.English: When I'm struggling with sleepiness, I drink a lot of coffee or try to move around as much as possible, but I hate it when I run out of time and can't get to the things I had planned to do.

dialogue.content: 具体的に教えて下さりありがとうございます。日中の覚醒度が低くなっていて、支障が出ているのですね。やはり、早寝はとても大切ですね。早寝して睡眠時間が確保でき、睡眠の質も高まれば、日中の生活の質が上がりますね。日中の生活の質が高まれば、感じるストレスも軽減できるのではないかと思うのですが、いかがですか？
dialogue.English: Thank you for explaining that in detail. It sounds like your low level of alertness during the day is causing disruptions. This really highlights how important it is to go to bed early. If you can go to bed earlier, get enough sleep, and improve your sleep quality, your quality of life during the day will likely improve. And if that happens, I imagine the stress you feel would lessen as well. How does that sound to you?

dialogue.content: そうかも知れませんね
dialogue.English: That might be true.

dialogue.content: ぐりさんにとって、夜のYouTubeと映画を観る時間はとても大切なストレス発散になっている。それはぐりさんにとっては必要な時間なのではないかと思うです。ただ、観る時間をもう少し短くして早く寝てみる。早寝して日中感じるストレスを軽減できれば、夜の大切なストレス発散時間も短くて済むようになるかもしれません。
dialogue.English: For you, that time watching YouTube and movies at night is a very important way to relieve stress—it seems like a necessary time for you. However, perhaps you could try shortening that viewing time a little and going to bed earlier. If going to bed earlier reduces the stress you feel during the day, you might find that you need less of that important unwind time in the evening.

dialogue.content: それは頭では重々分かっていて、毎日『明日からは！』と思っているのに、実行出来ない自分に、自己嫌悪になるんです…
dialogue.English: I understand that all too well intellectually. Every day I tell myself, 'I'll start tomorrow!', but when I can't follow through, I end up feeling self-loathing...

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。分かっているのに行動できないのはつらいですよね。でも、ぐりさんはもう何が大切なのかがすでにお分かりになっている。それを実行するためにぐりさんに何が一番必要だと思いますか？
dialogue.English: I hear you. It's hard when you know what to do but can't act on it. Still, you already understand what's important. What do you think you need most to put it into practice?

dialogue.content: 意志の強さでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Stronger willpower, perhaps?

dialogue.content: 意思の強さはすごく大切ですね。でも１～２時に寝ていたのを、２１～２２時に寝れるようにするには時間がかかると思います。すぐには難しいと思います。少しずつ寝る時間を早めてみることはできそうですか？
dialogue.English: Willpower is very important, of course. But going from a 1 or 2 AM bedtime to a 9 or 10 PM one will take time. I think it would be difficult to do all at once. Do you think it might be possible to shift your bedtime earlier, little by little?

dialogue.content: そうですね少しずつなら可能かなと思います
dialogue.English: Yes, I think I could probably do it little by little.

dialogue.content: 寝る時間を少しずつでいいので、早めていきましょう。もう少しでお時間になるのですが、他に伝えたいことはありますか？
dialogue.English: Great. Let’s work on moving your bedtime earlier, little by little. We’re almost out of time; is there anything else you’d like to share today?

dialogue.content: わかりましたやってみます大丈夫です
dialogue.English: Okay, I'll give it a try. No, that's all.

dialogue.content: (まだ続いてますか？)
dialogue.English: (Is this still ongoing?)

dialogue.content: (了解です)
dialogue.English: (Got it.)

dialogue.content: (復旧にはまだかかりそうでしょうか？)
dialogue.English: (Does it seem like it will take a while to resume?)

dialogue.content: 分かりましたでは終了させて頂きます
dialogue.English: Understood. I'll end the session now.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: お疲れ様でした
dialogue.English: Thank you for the session.
